7933.title: Digit-row shortcut normalization skips physical digit keys
7933.rootCauseOneLine: The shared normalizer skips Digit codes for punctuation and accented Latin key values, so decimal shortcuts do not match and recording saves symbols.
7933.proposedFix: Normalize valid digit-row codes before layout character fallback, retaining exact modifiers and legacy symbol matching.
7933.caveats: Synthetic keyboard events on Linux exercise the shared production matcher in two trusted checkouts; native macOS French input and packaged 0.49.0 were not exercised.
